You arrive in a kitchen. An usual kind of place. You begin looking for stuff.

You scan the room for a fridge, and you find a fridge. You can make out a closed oven. You make out a table. On the table you make out a cookbook. You bend down to tie your shoe. Isn't TextWorld just the best? You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a stove. The stove is conventional. But oh no! there's nothing on this piece of garbage.
